name: card
title: Card
description: The surface primitive: a bordered, rounded container with Media, Header, Title, Subtitle, Body, and Footer slots. Four surfaces (default surface-card, elevated, bleed translucent for coloured backgrounds, and inverse with text that flips to match), an elevation shadow from none to lg, a literal-px border width, token-scaled padding and radius, and optional whole-card press with a haptic. Compose image, metric, prompt, list, and carousel cards from its slots plus the shipped primitives — it ships no baked-in layouts.
